name: oxly
displayName: Oxly — Chrome DevTools for AI Agents
description: Trace, cost, and security observability for AI agents. Phase 5: 6 project-scoped read-only MCP tools + 4-skill pack (overview, trace-debug, security-triage, cost-report) + status UI + submission-ready manifests. Superset of Phase 4 with consistent pagination (total/limit/offset), strict validation, and full OpenAPI tool docs.

mcp.note: Phase 5 serves 6 read-only tools: query_traces, get_trace, get_span, query_security_alerts, cost_summary, whoami. Inspector must get init ok. query_traces/query_security_alerts return total + limit/offset echo (count kept on alerts); status/severity/interval validated case-insensitively; get_trace reports true total span_count with 200-span cap + spans_truncated; cost_summary validates start_date <= end_date; DEMO_MODE allows keyless calls with explicit project_id.

ui.note: Production UI assets MUST be hosted at the stable HTTPS origin allow-listed by the API Content-Security-Policy (frame-ancestors/script-src). Local dev serves packages/plugin/ui/ at /plugin/ui/.

auth.note: Every MCP tool takes the project's SDK API key (ak_...) as api_key and scopes to that project (explicit project_id must match). DEMO_MODE=true allows keyless calls with explicit project_id for local exploration.

legal.note: Placeholder links until the hosted docs site ships; submission reviewers follow these URLs.

rateLimits.note: MCP shares the API 100 req/min per-IP limiter; tools clamp limit/offset server-side (50 traces, 100 alerts). Back off on 429.
